versions.changelog:
- Initial release of unified web search skill with 3-tier fallback: Brave API → DuckDuckGo → claude.ai browser.
- Automatically caches all search results to memory/research/ with detailed metadata and insights.
- Supports custom search parameters: freshness, language, country, and method selection.
- Offers usage guidance, fallback logic, integration tips for other skills, and troubleshooting.
- No API key required for DuckDuckGo or claude.ai browser fallback methods.
